back:
Neutral at switch locations (with exceptions)
Grip center ≤ 6 ft 7 in. above floor
Metal faceplates/yokes grounded
Switches not in wet locations unless in weatherproof enclosures

Where GFCI/AFCI/TR/WR would be required today → install that type
No EGC in box: non-grounding, or GFCI marked 'No Equipment Ground', or grounding-type on a GFCI with both markings

front: Receptacles in damp vs wet locations
back:
Damp: cover weatherproof when closed (no plug inserted)
Wet: in-use cover (weatherproof with plug inserted) + WR-listed receptacle

More than 5½ ft above the floor
Part of a luminaire or appliance
Dedicated appliance receptacle (not easily moved)
Non-grounding replacements (406.4(D)(2)(a))

Bathtub/shower zone: 3 ft horizontal, 8 ft vertical — no cord/chain/pendant luminaires or fans
Closet: surface incandescent/LED enclosed 12 in.; surface fluorescent 6 in.; recessed enclosed 6 in.

Waste disposer: 18–36 in.
Dishwasher / trash compactor: 3 ft to 6½ ft
Range hood / microwave-hood: 18 in. to 4 ft (422.16(B)(4))

front: Motor sizing — which current for what?
back:
Table FLC (430.247–250): conductors (125%), OCPD, disconnect (115%)
Nameplate FLA: overloads (125% if SF ≥ 1.15 or rise ≤ 40°C, else 115%)

Nontime-delay fuse: 300%
Dual-element time-delay fuse: 175%
Instantaneous-trip breaker: 800%
Inverse-time breaker: 250%
(Next standard size up permitted per 430.52(C)(1) Ex. 1)

In sight of the controller AND in sight of the motor (or lockable per exception)
Rated ≥ 115% of FLC, or hp-rated
'In sight' = visible and ≤ 50 ft

front: Transformer primary OCPD (≤1000 V, primary only)
back:
Primary ≥ 9 A → 125% (next size up OK)
2 to < 9 A → 167%
< 2 A → 300%
With secondary protection: primary 250%, secondary 125% (≥ 9 A)

≤ 112½ kVA: 12 in. from combustibles (or barrier / fully enclosed)
> 112½ kVA: transformer room of fire-resistant construction (exceptions for Class 155+ insulation)
Ventilation openings unobstructed

Disconnect within sight AND readily accessible from the unit
Conductors ≥ 125% of RLA or branch-circuit selection current
OCPD per nameplate 'maximum fuse/breaker' marking

Directory: specific purpose, not 'lights'
Supply OCPD ≤ panelboard rating
Feed-through / subfeed lugs allowed; back-fed breakers must be secured (408.36(D))
